lastResponse.text: I hear you, and I’m really glad you asked. In Lane County, go now to in-person crisis support at 2411 Martin Luther King Junior Boulevard, Eugene. Asking for help there does not automatically mean being locked up. If you can’t get there, call the Lane County crisis line now: 541, 682, 1001. I can stay with you while you call. If you feel you might act on unsafe thoughts right now, call nine one one immediately.
originalTexts: I hear you, and I’m really glad you asked. In Lane County, go now to in-person crisis support at **2411 Martin Luther King Junior Boulevard, Eugene**. Asking for help there does **not** automatically mean being locked up. If you can’t get there, call the Lane County crisis line now: **541, 682, 1001**. I can stay with you while you call. If you feel you might act on unsafe thoughts right now, call **911** immediately.
